Estimation of W To quantify the divergence between the two distributions, we employ the Bhattacharyya distance [13], which offers a closed-form solution for Gaussian distributions, signifi- cantly enhancing computational efficiency. For Gaussian distributions p(eE[y]) = N (µy, σ2 y) and q(eE[f (x)]) = N (µf x, σ2 f x), the closed-form expression for the Bhat- tacharyya distanceDB is given by: DB(p∥q) = 1 4 (µy − µf x)2 σ2y + σ2 f x + 1 2 ln σ2 y + σ2 f x 2σyσf x ! , (4) where µy ≜ E[y] and µf x ≜ E[f (x)] denote the ex- pected brightness values, while σ2 y = ( σαE[y])2 and σ2 f x= (σβE[f (x)])2 characterize distribution spreads de- rived from Eq.
